descriptions.value: In JetBrains Ktor before 3.6.1 missing Domain attribute validation in client cookie storage allowed cookie injection

In multiple functions of rmmi_utility.c, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write due to a missing bounds check. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In bindDataService of DataServiceManager.java, there is a possible way to retain privileged tunnel management permissions across configuration updates due to a logic error. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In acquireMemory of bt_bqr_offload.cc, there is a possible way to trigger an out of bounds write via a buffer size underflow due to an incorrect bounds check. This could lead to local escalation of privilege with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.
